expectation: Na+/K+-ATPase should give a basolateral/lateral plasma-membrane ring on most epithelial cells, with a honeycomb in en-face view and lateral lines in side view. Epithelium should be bright (glands, crypts, lumen lining) and stroma and empty space dim.
observed: A: yellow signal traces the glandular and epithelial tissue folds and is dark outside the tissue. B: crisp honeycomb of cell outlines en face, plus lateral lines in side view. C: a gland with a bright columnar palisade of lateral membranes, dim lumen and nuclei. D: membrane-aligned streaks between cells.
why: Membrane-specific, epithelium-restricted signal with honeycomb and palisade patterns matches Na/K-ATPase and is not haze or debris.
